note: Set A covers the full page, including the Region 3 torque saturation, pitch-to-feather action, the force decrease toward the tip, and the Prandtl tip-loss drop in the outboard 5%, all of which Set B omits. Set B's six claims are all accurate and cleanly bound, but it misses several important facts. Set A does contain two misread claims (the 90 m location is where aerodynamic forces peak, not blade peak or peak deflection) and heavy duplication of the 4°, 0°, 9.0 and 8.5 values. On balance A's broader correct coverage outweighs its two errors and redundant entries.
